shared_context: Cheap Detour is a covers band. They are booked to play a wedding and need to settle on a twelve-song setlist. The next rehearsal is on Thursday, 2026-09-10. The band has not yet finalized the setlist as of the simulation start time.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the band has agreed on a complete twelve-song setlist at or before the end of Thursday's rehearsal (2026-09-10T22:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
